text: Return your attention to the body. Instead of thinking about how pleasant the tea you are drinking is, feel its warmth, taste, and aroma. Practice this with every action. Do not analyze, but actually feel: the water on your skin in the shower, the texture of your clothes, the firmness of the ground under your feet. This is the first step to coming out of the head and returning to living Life. As a second step, move toward this feeling until you dissolve into atoms, until a wave of emotional orgasm from the feeling that fills you—so powerful that in that instant the Universe familiar to you ceases to exist.
